interpretation_guardrails: Success rates are copied from rollout_summary.json and are not recomputed from incomplete traces.
Switch/action associations are descriptive and do not establish that switching causes failure.
A force or jamming claim requires measured force/contact or actual velocity fields; their absence is reported explicitly.
Comparisons across router packages or representation providers are not router-only causal comparisons.
Three seeds support descriptive uncertainty reporting, not a universal significance claim.
